analyst_view.overall: Early view: Sabadell are unbeaten at home (three wins, two draws) and built on defence, but one preview said they lost joint top scorer Nicholas Gioacchini to a cruciate ligament injury. Eibar are fourth with a good away record (four wins in six) but, according to one report, are without both left-backs, and they have a postponed league game and a Copa tie to fit in.

goals.text: The numbers say 1.9 goals. I lean higher: Sabadell's home games have averaged 2.4 goals and Eibar's away games three, and Eibar's defensive injuries make a very low total less likely.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners. Eibar won five corners and took 20 shots against Almería, and Sabadell are strong at home; I found nothing that clearly moves the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.6 cards. Sabadell have already had Édgar González and Óscar Sanz banned for five yellows, which shows a combative side, but that is in line with the site's number.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.3 shots, with 19 for Sabadell. I lean lower: Sabadell have scored only 12 goals all season and, without Gioacchini, are unlikely to shoot that often even at home.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.0 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: Eibar's shooting has been inaccurate (four on target from 20 against Almería) and Sabadell's attack is thin.
